title: Resolve both Crew seats using vote history and seeded draws
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement selectRepairCrew exactly as frozen in section B056 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Order highest votes first, then oldest lastCrewRound (null means never served), then seeded visible draw among the still-tied candidates. Preserve supplied fixed candidate order for draw indexing; use existing nextRandom. Choose second seat from remaining candidates. Fewer than two candidates returns decision-required D-ELIGIBLE-POOL; never appoint a Shift Lead tie-break.
acceptance: Highest totals win; a second-seat tie chooses longest-since-Crew, with never-served older than any recorded round.
Exact history ties consume reproducible RNG and emit candidate/selected evidence; untied choices do not consume RNG.
Reject duplicate IDs, negative/noninteger totals, future history and invalid RNG; no fallback is invented for fewer than two candidates.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
